author: Jay
text: Absolutely perfect communication and service. I need a couple utilities located, well and power. They were very professional and completed the job swiftly. Thanks!

author: Hugh Reusser
text: They came through like a champ ! Corrie and Darius came out as scheduled  got right to work and cleared my field drain  tile system pronto   and   then also the  French drains around the house- that were filled with walnuts from pesky squirrels! They  patiently helped me locate a collapsed field drain tile  with their hydrojet  equipment and  then cleared out  the mud-filled  obstruction ( and I replaced the collapsed  tile on the spot with a spare that I had on hand and they came back and finished the hydrojet cleaning ) . The service was professional thorough and straightforward, and price was less than 1/2 of a well known local major  competitor that I had called first ( but  after they cancelled on me 3 times I called J&S . I am GLAD I did. ) . The office staff were  friendly and helpful. The owner (Dan?) answered  all of my questions beforehand  and gave  me a very fair upfront quote.   In today’s   modern and  oftentimes impersonal  service world it is refreshing to run into a  locally run business like this  with what I call  a real Hoosier Hospitality attitude. I would not hesitate to refer them to my family and friends and  would certainly call them  first if my drains ever needed clearing once  again

author: Ashley
text:
I was referred to Daniel by a member of my church. They said they had a great experience with him and that I would be in great hands! He was a great! Daniel was so kind and reassuring; he made me definitely feel that I had the right guy after having four companies already come out. If I have any other issues I will always be calling and asking for Daniel! He was so sufficient and thorough. My father and I were very pleased with the work he conducted! We have had no issues since! As a first time home owner this was a scary situation but I was blessed to be put in the hands of J&S!
Thanks Daniel!

author: jeff haycox
text: I work for a Local Transportation company. So we have public restrooms. Had 5 toilets backed up no fault of our own. Called several Plumbers as it was a dire situation. They were booked. J&S said they could be there in 1.5 -2 hours. On time and did an awesome Job. Will use again.

author: Kenzie Tempel
text: Bryce and Todd were quick and efficient with getting our new grinder pump installed after I had tried to contact 3 separate plumbing companies to come and take a look. In less than 24 hours, Bryce came out, diagnosed the problem and had my new one installed which only took him an hour. Hopefully I won’t need to call again for another 5-7 years; but they will be my first call if I do.
